checks.must: POST /notifications/:id/read still sends X-CSRF-Token (via $.ajax or explicit header).
A 401 from React's requests still redirects to /login?next=..., or the loss of the global ajaxError handler is explicitly flagged.
The global #spinner (ajaxStart/ajaxStop) behavior is preserved or its loss is explicitly flagged.
The cache:false cache-busting of $.ajaxSetup is preserved or flagged when switching away from jQuery for GET.
The polling interval is cleared on unmount.
n.html is rendered as HTML as before (e.g. dangerouslySetInnerHTML) with the change of escaping behaviour noted, or the change to text rendering is explicitly called out.
